data.gender_notes: Adrial is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'adriana' derived from 'ad' meaning towards and 'religio' meaning faith, religion. Adrial signifies a man of God or devotee. The name Adrial carries the meaning “Man of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adrial usually hope their child will grow to embody man of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents a strong spiritual connection.
data.etymology: Adrial belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adrial total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
